title: The Rich Man and Lazarus
reflectionText: Lazarus lay at his gate every day, close enough to touch, and the rich man stepped past him every day. Now a chasm no one can cross is fixed between them. The distance that cannot be crossed was once only a gate — what distance is still only a gate for you?
editorialNotes: PAL Daily supervised production 2026-07-24, Batch C (gap CG13). Luke 16:19-31, the Rich Man and Lazarus, absent both lanes. SHORT only, WEB 300w / KJV 290w. Per owner direction the parable is rendered exactly with NO afterlife commentary in either direction: 'Hades'/'hell' (WEB/KJV lane words), 'Abraham's side'/'Abraham's bosom', the 'great chasm/gulf fixed', and 'this flame' are given as the text gives them, without explaining or systematizing them into doctrine. The reversal (16:25), the fixed gulf (16:26), the five brothers (16:27-28), and the closing 'neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead' (16:31) are all kept; the story ends on 16:31. KJV narration lightly restructured to avoid verbatim reproduction while preserving the essential dialogue and KJV register. TEXT DRAFT — AWAITING ADAM AND CHATGPT REVIEW.
